en: If you touch an icon and slide it{SAUT}{f 0 1 2}while the pencil tool is selected{f 0 1 0}...{PAGE}You can {f 0 1 2}place that icon on the map{f 0 1 0}.{PAGE}For example, shortcuts should be{SAUT}marked with their designated {f 0 1 2}icon{f 0 1 0}.{PAGE}The icon will {f 0 1 2}automatically display{f 0 1 0}{SAUT}the travel direction of the shortcut.
Any icons placed by mistake can be{SAUT}deleted by {f 0 1 2}dragging them to the trash can{f 0 1 0}.
A mistake in drawing walls or floors{SAUT}is removed with the {f 0 1 2}UNDO button{f 0 1 0}.

Your map has many other functions{SAUT}as well. Details can be found under {f 0 1 2}Help{f 0 1 0}{SAUT}at the map's bottom right.{SAUT}Don't forget to fill it in as you{SAUT}explore; you'll thank yourself later!
